requirements: R1: Authenticate via corporate credentials or standard login to issue a secure session token

slices.title: Enforce secure session token for authentication
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication logic for this epic, I want to issue secure session tokens upon valid login, so that the system's identity verification is securely enforced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they provide valid login credentials
Then the system issues a secure session token rather than trusting unverified HTTP headers
Given the need for test coverage
When the authentication flow is tested
Then the test validates that valid credentials yield a secure token and invalid ones are rejected

epics.title: Database Persistence for Comments and Update Requests
epics.jtbd: When viewing or reviewing a document, I want to submit comments and update requests, so that my feedback is stored persistently and content managers are notified.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce data loss for comments and update requests to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Ephemeral storage constraint for user feedback
requirements: R1: Store submitted comments and actualization requests in persistent database storage rather than ephemeral maps

slices.title: Implement database persistence for comments and actualization requests
slices.jtbd: When implementing data storage for this epic, I want to write comments and update requests to the database, so that feedback is persistently stored.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a document view
When a user submits a comment or update request
Then the data is written to persistent database storage instead of being stored only in ephemeral in-memory maps
Given the need for test coverage
When the persistence is tested
Then the test validates that data is successfully saved and retrieved from the database
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase feedback persistence rate from 0% to 100%

requirements: R1: Backend search filters for document update date and education level

slices.title: Implement backend search filters for update date and education level
slices.jtbd: When implementing the search logic for this epic, I want to filter queries by update date and education level on the database level, so that search results are accurately scoped.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search query
When the user applies update date or education level filters
Then the backend queries the database using these criteria rather than relying on frontend-only simulation
Given the need for test coverage
When the filters are tested
Then the test validates that only relevant documents matching the criteria are returned
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce irrelevant document retrieval by 100% for targeted queries
